ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixel distribution with a high-intensity (white) ratio estimated at approximately 5:95 across visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white mottling concentrated at the far left distal tip and scattered focal white spots along the trailing edge and medial-right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 50 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:4 relative to the notch opening.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated peaks and valleys extracted along the entire superior boundary of both lobes, with more pronounced jaggedness on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve transitioning to a slight convexity at the distal tips; the trailing edge follows a generally sigmoidal path from notch to tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small clusters of high-contrast white pixels located at the far left and far right distal tips, consistent with barnacle-related scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Series of vertical and diagonal linear rake marks on the right lobe; irregular chipping and loss of edge continuity on the far right trailing edge.
